description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2025: Structural Behavior Monitoring of a Full-Scale 10-Story Building using Drone-Based Tools is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jimena Barba, University of Texas at San Antonio (utsa.edu). This project focused on the structural analyzation of a full-scale 10-story building using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) at the Large High Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) at the University of California, San Diego. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-bgte-pd62. Keywords: NSF NHERI LHPOST6 UCSD, UAV, Cold-Formed Steel (CFS), Natural hazards, Research, Earthquake. Published 2025-08-30. Facility named: Six Degree of Freedom Large High-Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) - University of California, San Diego. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
